messages.subject: Open a link in new tab using ValeuBox href parameter
parts:
Hello,

I would like to open a web link in new tab using ValeuBox href parameter.

Please, can somebody help me?

Below my code:

ui.R

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)

ui <- dashboardPage(

  skin="red", 

  dashboardHeader(title= "PROJETOS DE SISTEMAS", titleWidth = 400),

  dashboardSidebar(disable= TRUE),

  dashboardBody(
  fluidRow(
      uiOutput("ui")
  )
  )
)

server.R
server <- function(input, output) {

  dash = read.table(file="dashboard.csv",header=T,sep=";")
  D <- as.matrix(dash)

    output$ui <- renderUI({
      lapply(1:nrow((D)), function(i) {
        tabBox(title = tagList(icon=icon(D[i,16]),D[i,7] ), width = 3, height = 150,
             valueBox(
                D[i,2], 
                paste(D[i,4], "a", D[i,5]), 
                icon =icon(D[i,14]),
                color = D[i,15],
                href = paste0(D[i,13], ".pdf")
              ),
             tabPanel(paste("Tarefas:", D[i,10], "/", D[i,9]))
         )
        })
    })
}

my application is working at: jssp.shinyapps.io/dash
